hypothesis: On RTX 4090 (SM89, 24GB VRAM), pi-H3 1.0 (DWD + INT8 ConvRot + Spark-Attn SM89) can generate 5s 768p video with synchronized stereo audio in <=35s when warm (matching or beating the official RTX 3090 gpu-unlock 34.6s figure), and 4-step mode improves detail over 2-step within ~50s.
purpose: Benchmark and visually/audibly compare pi-H3 DWD + Spark-Attn SM89 on RTX 4090 across 480p, 720p, 768p, and 1080p (upscaled & native) at 2 steps vs 4 steps.
scope: ComfyUI v0.46.0 + ComfyUI-piFlow v1.4.2 + Spark-H3 v0.2.0 SM89 inside Docker on Windows 11 WSL2 with RTX 4090.

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24564 MiB VRAM, SM 8.9)

conclusion: 16 of 17 runs succeeded on RTX 4090 with zero Spark-H3 dense fallbacks. Warm end-to-end generation (models loaded + prompt encoded, including DWD Decode, Audio VAE Decode, and MP4 save) took 19.729s (480p 2-step), 28.367s (480p 4-step), 32.876s (720p 2-step), 49.715s (720p 4-step), 32.324s (768p 2-step, beating official RTX 3090 gpu-unlock 34.6s), 49.390s (768p 4-step), 39.905s (1080p upscaled 2-step), and 62.503s (1080p upscaled 4-step). Native 1920x1088 with chunk_path=drop_k failed because spark_h3_kitchen 0.2.37 lacks the split-attention CUDA extension.
limitations: Very first cold start over WSL2 9p mount (/mnt -> D:\Prj\minimax-h3-compose\models) plus initial Triton/torch compile took 1463.079s.
Audio quality was verified quantitatively via ffprobe (AAC 32kHz stereo) and ffmpeg astats (RMS -13.9 to -15.0 dB), not listened to by human ears.
